predictions: Ok, now here we go!! A big ol' 19-4 record last week!! And one of those four that I missed went all the way to 1001. That's a pretty strong week, if you ask me. Adding that to my decent first week, we now sit at a stout 35-11 (76.1% correct). And I'm at 5-3 or better in every division so far (get it together, F division), so I'm ok with all of it. Heck, I even nailed a shorthanded 12-10 outcome exactly last week. Oh, yeah, buddy.

Match of the week: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Darty Minds. The Attack's heroic 501 run last week has set up a huge showdown among a pair of B's three undefeated squads. And while I love to build picks off a prior emotional boost, I think Darty Minds is just visiting B for a few months on their way back to A. And they're quite a decent A team, so I think that translates to being a great freakin' B team. I'll go with Darty, 15-9.

Match #2: (F Div.) Liquor Possee @ Runs with Corks. Oh, F is starting as a super-tight race, with no team averaging more than 14 so far (and that team isn't even one of the 2-0s). Squeezing out narrow victories in even matchups is going to be the hallmark of the eventual F champion. Is this the eventual top-two? I think I'll take the Corks in the last 501.

Matches #3 & #4: (A Div.) Ring of Elements @ Lunatic Fringe; Liver Alliance @ The Bullies. The A schedule is a little more "mixed" and less segmented than in some seasons, so we have the first round of monster matchups here in week 3 instead of waiting until week 5. All four of these teams are undefeated and averaging 15.5 or more, so the importance of this early night is pretty obvious. The overall talent of all the teams but Fringe is about the same as last season (and Fringe has gotten better rather than worse). Huge early matchups… I have to go with my own Element squad, 16-8; and I will assume that The Bullies show up in full form and handle their business as well, 16-8.

Match #5: (C Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Dysfunctional Outlaws. The Bandits rang up one big set last week, or else this would be two undefeated teams with nothing but nailbiter wins. The Bandits have their second win already (the Outlaws have had a bye already), but I'm thinking this one ends with both having two wins. Outlaws, 14-10.

Matches #6 & #7: (D Div.) Hump Day! @ DD-214; Reload @ Menace 2 Sobriety. Look at the match scores in D so far… nothing is going to come easy around these parts. DD and Menace are the only two undefeated teams left, and they've only played 3 matches between them. And Menace, at only 1-0 with 15 points, is the only D team not averaging below 14 so far. These are tough calls, but I think I'll start by sticking with DD-214 again, 13-11; and Reload tightens the pack a bit by handing Menace its first loss here, 13-11.

Match #8: (A Div.) Why So Serious? @ Put It on Matt's Tab. The current A division is one of the better incarnations of A from the past many years. And winning the right to stay among that upper echelon is a big deal. I'm thinking Serious squeezes this one, 13-11.

Match #9: (E Div.) Village Idiots @ Death Throw. Yep, the Idiots are only 1-1 and sitting in 4th place. But if you look closer, they're actually just one bad 501 set from taking out the Rangers and sitting in the lead pair. File me under "New Believers". Idiots climb, 14-10.

Match #10: (G Div.) Killer Dee's @ The Rock Bottoms. Is this the Dee's first venture into RDL victory land? Or is this where the Rock Bottoms re-enter the title chase in G? Well, likely neither since the Dart Knights are monsters, but the Bottoms start chasing 2nd, 15-9.

Match #11: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Sofa Kings. Another super tight division with no team averaging above 14 per week. For these two 1-1 teams (sitting between three 2-0s and three 0-2s), this is a wildly pivotal swing point here in week 3. Sofa claims the 1001.

Match #12: (B Div.) Trips Are For Kids @ Iceman's. Kids sits 0-2 and in next to last… but they're only about 3 darts from being 2-0. Alas, I think a third close loss is on the horizon. Iceman's, 14-10.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
B Division: Raging Bulls 14, Trippin Bulls 10; Show Me Your Tips… ummm, present?, Uber Out… maybe mostly absent?
C Division: Nine Lives 12, Rif Raf 10; Stumble Out 16, Constantly 8.
D Division: Shooter McGavin 13, Bad Mutha Duckas 11.
E Division: Rangers 17, Y.N.T.A. 7; Machine 14, Ton 80 Proof 10.
F Division: Dart Side 15, Bangin 9; Rippin 14, Shark Shooters 10.
G Division: Nein Mark 16, Salute 8; We Throw It 15, Triple Shots 9.
